data.body:
MERGED. Gerrit 3264 patchset 3 (`9f95ab706aaf19aa054c6c05d3123a0ef86ff477`) earned
LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments, and was submitted revision-scoped.
Change status is MERGED.

The patchset-2 Verified -1 is fully accounted for: it was repo-root pollution from this
story's own test, root-caused to the Pass-1 checkpoint store following `repo_root` into the
real checkout, and fixed by redirecting `_checkpoint_dir` under `tmp_path` in the
`plan_reads` fixture. The proof is the absence of the directory, not a passing test:
`.rebar/cache` was deleted and the FULL suite re-run, and it was not recreated. CI
confirmed it independently — all 3 ubuntu pytest cells plus macos passed on a clean
checkout.

AC VERIFICATION against the merged tree, from the `impl-a350` worktree at that commit.
tests/unit/test_plan_review_overlap.py carries 20 test functions, 23 collected after
parametrization, all passing.

AC1 — seeded candidate plus the cap. test_seeded_candidate_reaches_the_prompt_and_lands_advisory
(a seeded ticket is named in the injected prompt and an attributed finding survives the run)
and test_more_than_five_matches_inject_exactly_five (8 seeded, exactly 5 named, asserting
RESULT_LIMIT == 5). MET.

AC2 — the off switch is total, 4 tests. test_off_emits_no_overlap_finding,
test_off_keeps_the_criterion_out_of_batch_resolution,
test_off_leaves_checkpoint_identity_byte_identical, test_on_adds_no_llm_call. MET.

AC3 — never pass-to-block, 3 tests. test_routing_posture_is_advisory,
test_decide_pass_places_the_finding_in_advisory,
test_a_passing_plan_stays_passing_with_an_overlap_finding — the last also asserting
orchestrator._any_blocking_criterion is False for the decided finding. MET.

AC4 — compatibility, 2 tests. test_find_similar_without_diagnostics_is_unchanged (the
recent_creates.py call shape) and test_lexical_tier_serves_with_no_model_provider. MET.

AC5 — degradation, one per status. test_degraded_retrieval_records_its_status_and_changes_nothing
parametrized over index-absent, catch-up-failed and retrieval-error, each asserting the
recorded status, an empty finding set, and a verdict equal to the overlap=False run. MET.

Patchset 3 also adds test_an_honest_empty_match_is_recorded_as_ok_not_as_degradation, which
the code reviewer correctly identified as the uncovered half of this contract: every
degraded path also reports zero candidates, so `candidates == 0` alone carries no
information and only the status discriminates. Without it a regression reporting an empty
result set as retrieval-error would have passed the whole module. RED-proved by exactly
that mutation; overlap.py reverted byte-identical.

AC6 — the tree-wide gates, measured not assumed. Every src/rebar file touched by this
commit is within the cap: __init__.py 601, overlap.py 91, pass1.py 681,
production_batch_runner.py 328, gate_dispatch.py 777, similar/__init__.py 109 — max 777
against the 800 limit. `check_mechanism_delta.py --check` RC=0 and
`check_complexity_baseline.py --check` RC=0. MET.

Full `make verify` RC=0 on the merged tree: 20490 passed / 27 skipped in the default tier
(38:44), 203 passed / 3 skipped in the integration tier (2:54), 0 FAILED and 0 ERROR.

No `# mechanism-ok:` marker names this ticket as its sunset, so d68f's new close precheck
does not apply.

Closing.
